scope: pre-Brock (Pallet Town through Pewter City gym / Boulder Badge)

flagBase.note: Flag bit-offsets resolved from include/constants/flags.h by evaluating the decomp's own expressions (SYS_FLAGS + 0x20, FLAG_0x4FF + 1, FLAG_HIDDEN_ITEMS_START + N, ...). Trainer defeat flags are TRAINER_FLAGS_START + trainerId (from opponents.h), matching the engine's FlagSet for trainers. A runtime reader reads a flag by bitOffset = value: byte = floor(v/8), bit = v % 8 — see gamestate/overworld/playerData.js readPlayerFlag.

note: completion.mode 'all' = every flag must be set; 'any' = any one (used for starter-dependent battles, where only the variant matching the chosen starter is ever set). 'optional' milestones are real story beats the pre-Brock path can skip (Route 22 rival + its Poké Ball top-up); the critical path is chose_starter -> beat_rival_oaks_lab -> got_oaks_parcel -> got_pokedex -> defeated_brock -> got_boulder_badge.

milestones.name: Chose Starter Pokémon
milestones.description: Player picks one of the three starter Poké Balls on Oak's table and receives the monster. FLAG_SYS_POKEMON_GET is set in PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_EventScript_ChooseStarter; FLAG_PALLET_LADY_NOT_BLOCKING_SIGN is set in the same scene so the player can leave town.
milestones.reward: First party member; enables field battles and the Pallet Town exit.

milestones.name: Defeated Rival in Oak's Lab
milestones.description: Immediately after choosing a starter, the rival challenges the player to a first battle in the lab. FLAG_BEAT_RIVAL_IN_OAKS_LAB is set after the trainerbattle resolves. The rival's party depends on the chosen starter, so the trainer-defeat flag is one of three variants.
milestones.reward: Story gate cleared to leave the lab.

milestones.name: Received Oak's Parcel
milestones.description: The Viridian Mart clerk hands the player OAK'S PARCEL (a key item) to deliver to Prof. Oak. There is no dedicated setflag for receiving the parcel — the scene is gated by goto_if_unset FLAG_SYS_POKEDEX_GET and a per-map scene var (VAR_MAP_SCENE_VIRIDIAN_CITY_MART), and the item itself (ITEM_OAKS_PARCEL) is what tracks it. Delivery immediately proceeds to the Pokédex milestone, so FLAG_SYS_POKEDEX_GET marks the parcel quest *resolved*.

completion.note: No dedicated flag; tracked by the OAK'S PARCEL key item. See got_pokedex for the resolved flag.

milestones.reward: Oak's Parcel key item; required to advance the Oak's Lab Pokédex scene.

milestones.name: Delivered Parcel / Received Pokédex
milestones.description: Returning to Oak's Lab with the parcel triggers PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_EventScript_ReceiveDexScene: Oak takes the parcel, the rival enters, and Oak gives the player the Pokédex plus 5 Poké Balls. FLAG_SYS_POKEDEX_GET is set at the end of that scene.
milestones.reward: Pokédex + Poké Balls; enables catching and is the precondition for the Route 22 rival.

milestones.name: Defeated Route 22 Rival (optional)
milestones.description: A trigger-based (coord_event) early rival fight on Route 22, branched on VAR_STARTER_MON into one of three TRAINER_RIVAL_ROUTE22_EARLY_* trainerbattle calls. No dedicated story flag is set for this win — completion is the trainer-defeat flag (any of the three variants). Optional: not required to reach Pewter, but returning to Oak afterward grants extra Poké Balls (got_pokeballs_topup).
milestones.reward: Story beat only; gates the Oak Poké Ball top-up.

milestones.name: Received Poké Ball Top-up from Oak (optional)
milestones.description: After the Route 22 rival, returning to Oak's Lab out of Poké Balls triggers a 5-ball top-up. FLAG_GOT_POKEBALLS_FROM_OAK_AFTER_22_RIVAL is set, which in turn sets FLAG_OAK_SKIP_22_RIVAL_CHECK (a derived flag, not a primary milestone). Optional and not on the path to Brock.

milestones.name: Defeated Brock
milestones.description: PewterCity_Gym's victory script sets FLAG_DEFEATED_BROCK and FLAG_BADGE01_GET together. The trainer-defeat flag (TRAINER_LEADER_BROCK) is also set by the trainerbattle. Completion is satisfied by FLAG_DEFEATED_BROCK (the dedicated story flag) OR the trainer-defeat flag.

milestones.name: Received Boulder Badge
milestones.description: Set in the same Pewter Gym victory script as FLAG_DEFEATED_BROCK. This is the terminal pre-Brock milestone — the project's scope ends here.
